what_it_does: This paper designs a high-speed memory interface (PHY) for HBM3 (high-bandwidth memory generation 3) on Intel's most advanced 4-nanometer process. The interface transmits data at 7.2 gigabits per second while using just 0.5 picojoules of energy per bit transmitted. It uses EMIB (a special packaging technology that combines multiple chips on one package) and clever receiver design to maintain signal quality across temperature changes and manufacturing variations.
